subsubthemes.name: Shrinking numbers to save memory
subsubthemes.gist: Converting model weights to lower precision (like 2-bit or 4-bit instead of standard 32-bit) to reduce memory and speed up inference.

subsubthemes.name: Removing unnecessary parts of the network
subsubthemes.gist: Identifying and deleting redundant layers, channels, or connections that don't contribute much to accuracy, making models leaner and faster.

subsubthemes.name: Teaching a smaller model from a larger one
subsubthemes.gist: Using a large model's knowledge to train a smaller model that runs faster but keeps similar accuracy.

subsubthemes.name: Finding simpler patterns in data
subsubthemes.gist: Breaking down matrices or tensors into simpler components that capture the same information with fewer numbers.

subsubthemes.name: Smartly routing between model variants
subsubthemes.gist: Using mixture-of-experts and other dynamic routing to let the model choose which parts to use for each input, balancing speed and accuracy.

subsubthemes.name: Speeding up inference with smart caching
subsubthemes.gist: Reducing the memory footprint of key-value caches during long-sequence reasoning by compressing, pruning, or storing less information.
